title: Paloma Business Seat Pricing Footnote: Volume Reduction per Extra Seat
content:
Extra seats on a Paloma Business account carry a volume reduction per seat decided by the active users beyond the plan's included seats, the active users being the owner plus every user added less every user removed.

| Active users beyond the included seats | Volume reduction per seat |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 2.00 USD |
| 2 to 5 | 1.00 USD |
| 1 | None |
| 0 | None |

As a clause: 6 or more active users beyond the included seats earn a volume reduction of 2.00 USD per seat; 2 to 5 earn 1.00 USD per seat; a single one earns none.

The volume reduction is taken off the plan's extra seat fee for each seat charged; the per-seat fee is never below 0.00.

### Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A Paloma Business Pro account (10 included seats) with 17 active users has 7 beyond the included seats: 2.00 USD per seat, so a plan extra seat fee of 7.00 USD becomes 5.00 USD per seat.
- A Paloma Business Essentials account (3 included seats) with 5 active users has 2 beyond: 1.00 USD per seat, 9.00 USD becoming 8.00 USD.
- A Paloma Business Growth account (5 included seats) with 6 active users has 1 beyond: no volume reduction.
